findings.title: Preserve recorded logs when deriving a test logger from context
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new, unrelated TestLogger, so calls on the returned logger are not recorded on the original test logger. LoggerMiddleware now emits every completion log through logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), which means a TestLogger supplied to that middleware no longer exposes those logs through its InfoLogs field. Return the same recorder or share recording state with the derived logger so logging assertions remain meaningful.
